नवरात्रि रंग 2034 / Navratri Colors 2034

नवरात्रि 2034 के नौ रंग: शारदीय नवरात्रि 13 अक्टूबर 2034 से शुरू होती है। हर दिन एक रंग पहना जाता है, जो उस दिन की देवी और वार से जुड़ा माना जाता है। पहला दिन शुक्रवार को है, इसलिए पहले दिन का रंग हरा है।

Day 1 of Navratri 2034 is Friday, 13 October 2034, colour: Green. Colours follow the weekday of each day; the last two days are purple and peacock green.

नवरात्रि रंगों का महत्व / Why colours matter

Wearing the colour of the day is a custom, not a rule of scripture. It is most popular in Gujarat and Maharashtra, where groups of women dress in the same colour each day for garba and puja. The colours listed here follow the weekday scheme most calendars use; if your family or temple follows another order, keep that one.

For the full date list including Ghatasthapana, Durga Ashtami and Dussehra, see Sharad Navratri 2034.

FAQs

Navratri 2034 ka pehle din ka rang kya hai? / What is the colour of day 1 in 2034?

Day 1 of Sharad Navratri 2034 falls on Friday, 13 October 2034, so the colour is Green (हरा).

Navratri ke 9 rang kaise tay hote hain?

A common practice is to follow the weekday of each day: orange (Sunday), white (Monday), red (Tuesday), royal blue (Wednesday), yellow (Thursday), green (Friday) and grey (Saturday). The last two days are purple and peacock green. Some regions and temples follow a different order.

Navratri colours 2034 list

Day 1 (13 October 2034): Green; Day 2 (14 October 2034): Grey; Day 3 (15 October 2034): Orange; Day 4 (16 October 2034): White; Day 5 (17 October 2034): Red; Day 6 (18 October 2034): Royal Blue; Day 7 (19 October 2034): Yellow; Day 8 (20 October 2034): Purple; Day 9 (21 October 2034): Peacock Green.

Dates are for Delhi (IST). Colour schemes differ by region and tradition.
